title: Understanding LASSO Regularization
text: LASSO regularization adds a penalty equal to the absolute value of the magnitude of coefficients. This can lead to some coefficients being exactly zero, effectively removing some features from the model.

title: Effect on Model Complexity
text: Using LASSO regularization can reduce model complexity by shrinking some coefficients to zero. How might this affect the model's ability to generalize to new data?

title: Impact on Test Data MSE
text: Consider how reducing model complexity with LASSO might affect the MSE on held-out test data. Could it potentially increase, decrease, or both?
